components.name: CMS Primary Button
components.description: Default action for CMS forms and operational flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #000; color: #f7f0e7; padding: 12px 20px; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c13814; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: rgba(0,0,0,.06); color: rgba(0,0,0,.22); cursor: default; }

components.name: CMS Outline Button
components.description: Secondary CMS action with a visible structural boundary.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { border: 1px solid #000; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #000; padding: 10px 20px; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,0,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,.06); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #c13814; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: CMS Surface

narrative.overview:
Middleware V2 treats an Italian digital publication as an authored object: Archive Paper grounds the page, black rules establish the reading structure, and dense Archivo headlines give every issue a clear editorial voice. Spectral carries long-form reading with a quieter, literary cadence. The public experience makes the dossier and its content primary; the CMS preserves the same exacting grammar for operational work.

The system is flat by default and precise rather than polite. Borders, paper-to-white shifts, and a restrained Vermilion Proof mark do the work usually delegated to glossy surfaces. Responsive layouts retain the grid's logic while releasing multi-column structures into clear stacked reading order.
keyCharacteristics: Material paper ground, firm black structure, and rare rust-red proof marks.
Typography-led hierarchy with sans-serif display contrast and serif reading text.
Compact, deliberate controls with visible, high-contrast keyboard focus.
Editorial public surfaces and operational CMS surfaces drawn from one token system.

rules.name: The One Proof Rule
rules.body: Vermilion Proof marks attention, state, or consequence. It must not become a broad fill or a decorative field.

rules.name: The Type Does the Sorting Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy through family, weight, scale, and spacing before introducing color or ornamental treatment.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add soft floating shadows, glass effects, or blur to manufacture hierarchy. A rule, tonal shift, or stateful inset rail is the native depth language.

dos: Do preserve Archive Paper as the broad public ground and let Paper White indicate a contained operational surface.
Do use black rules to make grids, reading order, and interaction boundaries visible.
Do reserve Vermilion Proof for attention, focus, selection, destructive intent, and editorial numbering.
Do pair Archivo hierarchy with Spectral editorial reading text.
Do keep public dossier cards square and use the 6px and 8px radii only for controls and CMS panels.
donts: Don't add glossy dashboard chrome: gradients, glass blur, decorative shadows, or pill-heavy controls do not belong here.
Don't turn every content unit into a rounded card; preserve the dossier's rule-led grid.
Don't use the accent as a broad background color or a substitute for typographic hierarchy.
Don't replace visible focus outlines with subtle color-only hover treatment.
